gloss: confidential; for internal use only; company secret

definitions.gloss: confidential; for internal use only; not to be disclosed outside the company
definitions.explanation: A classification label stamped on documents, files, or information that must not be shared with anyone outside the organization. One of several standard confidentiality levels used in Japanese business.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{資料|しりょう}→資料：04166_shiryou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{社外秘|しゃがいひ}です。
{社外秘|しゃがいひ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{漏|も}らして→漏らす：02436_morasu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いけない。
examples.english: You must not leak confidential company information.

examples.japanese: {社外秘|しゃがいひ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{書|か}かれた→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦{封筒|ふうとう}→封筒：02952_fuutou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{取|と}った→受け取る：01883_uketoru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{企画書|きかくしょ}→企画書：20593_kikakusho⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{社外秘|しゃがいひ}⟦{扱|あつか}い→扱い：12777_atsukai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧お{願|ねが}いします。
examples.english: Please treat this proposal as confidential.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{社外|しゃがい}→社外：17992_shagai⟧ (outside the company) and {秘|ひ} (secret, confidential). The word literally means "secret from those outside the company" and is used as a classification stamp on documents.

Japanese companies typically use a hierarchy of confidentiality labels. From least to most restrictive: {社外秘|しゃがいひ} (not to be shared outside the company), {部外秘|ぶがいひ} (not to be shared outside the department), and ⟦{極秘|ごくひ}→極秘：13162_gokuhi⟧ (top secret). {社外秘|しゃがいひ} is the most commonly encountered level.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {社外秘|しゃがいひ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{資料|しりょう}→資料：04166_shiryou⟧: confidential documents
- {社外秘|しゃがいひ}⟦{扱|あつか}い→扱い：12777_atsukai⟧: treated as confidential
- {社外秘|しゃがいひ}⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧: confidential information
- {社外秘|しゃがいひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{漏|も}らす→漏らす：02436_morasu⟧: to leak confidential information

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {部外秘|ぶがいひ}: restricted to one's own department — more restrictive, limited to a specific division
- ⟦{極秘|ごくひ}→極秘：13162_gokuhi⟧: top secret, strictly confidential — the highest level of secrecy
- ⟦{機密|きみつ}→機密：13179_kimitsu⟧: classified, confidential — a broader, more general term for secrecy, not limited to corporate contexts
